paragraphs.text: Cassandra Khaw (pseudonym for Zoe Khor-Thu Ee ) is a Malaysian writer. They have published several horror and science fiction short stories.
In 2018, Khaw was hired by Wizards of the Coast as the head writer for a series of three episodes about Magic: The Gathering ’s planeswalker character Vivien Reid .
Cassandra also contributed to the Magic Story for Phyrexia: All Will Be One and Tarkir: Dragonstorm .
